about: side-view gunfire: a pistol flash, a heavy rifle flash, a rapid-fire loop and a brass shell casing that flips out and bounces

animations.name: shot
animations.about: a pistol shot: a white-hot flash at the barrel, a tongue of flame forward and a few sparks (plays once, ends empty)

animations.name: shot-big
animations.about: a heavy shot (rifle, shotgun): a longer flame, a fireball that breaks up at the barrel and more sparks (plays once, ends empty)

animations.name: auto
animations.about: rapid fire: three flashes of different shapes, one every 100 ms (seamless loop)

animations.name: shell
animations.about: a brass casing flips up out of the gun, tumbles, lands 13 px below the barrel (its first touch dips a pixel lower), bounces a pixel, lies still on its side and is gone (plays once, ends empty)
